generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
All necessary drawings, paper works, etc. and any other formalities required to be observed shall be the responsibility of contractor.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Whenever executing authority insists proof of having purchased the materials (used during executing the work) for verification, the contractor shall produce the purchase bills.

The contractor shall guarantee all the materials supplied by him including erection, electrification work for trouble free top class performance and against manufacturing defects for a period of one year from the date of satisfactory completion, commissioning and handing over to user department. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for rectifying defects/replacement of defective materials immediately on receipt of intimation from executing authority and power supply shall be restored. Failure of which, action will be taken to get the work rectification through other agency at the risk and cost of the contractor.
The quantities shown in the schedule are approximate. The actual quantities will be executed as per site condition only. Any balance materials shall be taken back by the contractor.

The contractor shall not deviate/alter/execute excess quantities or additional items without prior approval before placing the order joint site inspection will be made by Executive Engineer (Elect.)/ Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele) PWD.
It is the responsibility of the contractor to pursue and obtain all necessary approvals related to work from respective departments.
During the execution of any Minor Civil works or any other minor works which are to be executed, has to be done by the bidder from his end without any charges.

The contractor should see that the existing installation and working of the same are not affected during execution. Only after satisfactorily completion, and charging of new lines, the existing installation, if any shall be dismantled by duly informing to the Department. A site order book of the work shall be maintained and the contractor shall acknowledge the order given by the officers and shall carryout accordingly.
The tenderer shall pass on to the department all the warranties, benefits etc., from the original equipment manufacturers.

The Contractor shall be solely responsible, not withstanding any stipulation by Owner or Engineer, for initiating, maintaining and supervising all safety precautions and programs in connection with the work and shall comply with all laws, ordinances, codes, rules, regulations and lawful orders of any public authority having jurisdiction for the safety of persons or property or to protect them from damages, injury or loss during the entire contract period, including non-working hours. Contractor shall maintain first aid facilities at site. All critical injuries shall be reported promptly to Engineer with a copy of Contractors report covering each personal injury, requiring the attention of a physician.

The Contractor shall submit to the employer, for his review and approval, all shop drawings, samples, materials lists, equipment data, instruction manuals, record documents, manufacturers equipment manuals, and other information required by the Contract Documents, before use and execution and before bringing the material at Site.

The Contractor shall supervise and carry out the Works as per the approved shop drawings or part there of efficiently and with his best skill and attention. He shall be solely responsible for means, methods, techniques, procedures and sequences of construction. The Contractor shall coordinate all parts of the Works and shall be responsible to see that the finished work complies fully with the Contract Documents, and such other instructions and variation orders as the Engineer may issue during the progress of the Works. The Contractor, at no point of time, shall blame the Owner and or the Project Management Consultant, for the wrong doings of the Contractor, in any part of Works.

The tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer Or District level Officer and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate/ Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The tenderer shall scan the original ownership document/ lease / hire commitment Agreement scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid.
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
Tenderer shall note that the tenders those found Eligible to the conditions mentioned in Section-3 Qualification Instructions to Tenderers (ITT) will only be considered for further evaluation.
All materials required for this work, shall be procured by the Tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities, at his own cost before use on the work.

All the items includes with all Leads and Lifts, Loading and Unloading, Cost of materials, Labour, Hiring of machineries as per Standard specifications and as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work and other incidental items which are necessary for the successful completion of the work.

The entire work shall be carried out under the direct supervision of Officers in charge, Executive Engineer (Elect) and Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele). In all cases of differences, disputes, etc., regarding the interpretation of specification of condition in general with any of the work, the decision of E.E (Ele) PWD Division, Bangalore shall be final and binding on the contractor.

SHOP DRAWINGS: Contractor must submit well in advance shop drawings for approvals by the Engineer-in-Charge and approvals must be obtained before proceeding for execution of the works. DIGITAL FORMAT: All the Documents and drawings shall be as a Hard copy as well as on a Digital format in requisite numbers as per the direction of the Engineer-in-Charge.

The project shall be completed well within the contract period, the Tenderer should maintain the works of his scope during the defect liability period, which is 1Year after the successful completion of the work.
Co- Ordinating / solving the right of way problems is responsibility of LEC, in co-ordination with PWD/ local authorities BESCOM.
Tree Cut/ trimming of trees, in Co- Ordination with forest Dept. etc., is the responsibility of bidder / LEC in the way of shifting lines etc.
All the electrical materials which are bind to be used, before dispatching from the manufacture end shell be inspected by Executive Engineer (Ele), PWD.

Clause 25.5 stipulates for Tenderer to produce detailed rate analysis for various items if tender is seriously unbalanced. (i.e., where quoted rates are very high as well as where the quoted rates are less than estimated rated).

The bidders should submit the Bid capacity compulsorily. The details of balance work B value (works on hand & works for which tender submitted). Should be submitted in the prescribed format & should be signed by the concerned Executive Engineer / District level officer. In case the bidder does not furnish the above details/suppresses the actual facts/ produces false facts, along with the Technical bid, the technical bid of such bidder shall be considered for rejection

It is the responsibility of the Tenderer who executes the works to get services of the installations from the concerned Service Electricity Companies duly obtaining approval from the govt. electrical inspectorate as the case may be. However the department will pay the deposit/statutory fees if any after hearing the respective statutory bodies.

The contractor should arrange for the visit of The Executive Engineer (Elect.) and Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele.), PWD Electrical Division to the manufacturing premises for inspection and conducting tests as per ISI specifications on LT UG cable before dispatch of the materials at his cost, only after approval from the Executive Engineer (Elect.)/ Assistant Executive Engineer (Ele.) PWD, the materials shall be dispatched or otherwise the cable will not be accepted at site. The manufacturer shall have all testing and laboratory facilities in their premises and contractor shall be present at the premises to make arrangements for conducting tests.

After delivery at site, the materials will be inspected, if the materials do not conform to relevant ISS/ISI and technical specifications, then such materials will be rejected. The contractor shall remove the rejected materials at his own cost.

It is the responsibility of contractor to co-ordinate with executing authority for commissioning the Street lights satisfactory by observing all formalities up to handing over to the user department. After this only, final bill shall be prepared.
The contractor must obtain the approvals form the Electrical Inspectorate Government of Karnataka if necessary.

It is the responsibility of the tenderer to prepare the as build sketch of detail Road lighting and hand over the same to the end user as per the instructions of the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-1 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.
The Contractor must obtain the necessary approvals as per fire norms from the concerned fire authority.
It is the responsibility of the contractor in obtaining permission from the concerned railway authority for laying Cables across Railway crossings.
The Tenderer must submit ongoing and existing commitments details separately.
The tenderer should furnish Name and Address Telephone Nos. Fax Nos. and email ID of the Tenderers Bankers detail.
As per Karnataka State Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and G.No. PW/134/BMS/2007 Dt. 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted welfare fund.
As per the Govt. Order No PW2BMS2019 Bangalore Dated 19-06-2019 the applicable GST shall be paid to the SR Items separately.
Conditional Tenders will not be accepted.

The available tender capacity will be calculated as under/ Assessed available tender capacity -(AxNx2.5-B) Where, A-Maximum value of construction works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. 0.50 Years (06 Months) B - Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next. 0.50 Years (06 Months) (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.

itemList.description:
Manual Means -
Earth work   excavation by manual means for drains, canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of Buildings & bridges and such simillar works in all kinds of soils, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including  setting  out,   shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,  removal of stumps and other deleterious matter,   excavated surface leveled and sides neatly  dressed  disposing  off  the  excavated  stuff  or  sorting  &    stacking  the selected  stuff for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 1.5 m ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete   for all Foundation   works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers  laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators,   including all lead & lifts,   cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery,   curing and all the other   appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Mechanical Means -
Earth work  excavation for pipeline trenches in all kinds of soils by mechanical means  as  per  drawing  and  technical  specifications,  including  setting  out, construction  of  shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,  bracing,  using sight rails & bonding rods at every 100 mm wherever necessary as directed, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, dressing of sides and  levelling the bottom  of trench  to the extent required , utilising the available excavated earth  locally  for  the  work  etc.,  and  all  other  appurtenances  complete  in  the following strata. All kinds of soils. Depth upto 1.50 m ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Providing PVC ringtite pipes conforming to IS 4985:2000 with latest amendments and conveying to worksite, rolling and lowering into trenches, laying true to line and level and perfect linking at joints, testing and commissioning, including loading unloading at both destinations and cuts of pipes wherever necessary including jointing  of PVC pipes and specials (excluding cost of specials) with jointing of approved type, with all labour with all lead & lift including encasing the pipe alround to a depth of not less than 15 cms. with soft gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc. complete and giving necessary hydraulic test to the required pressure as per ISS (Contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) etc. complete For: PVC pipes 50mm dia., 6 kg/sqcm & class 5 ---- Items of work are including cost and conveyance of all materials, labour charges for all items of work with all lead and lift, loading and unloading and HOM of machineries etc., complete as per directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
